title: Production QMP boundary rejects runtime PCI mutation
blocker: The E3 component gate proves a default-deny QMP boundary around one emulated QEMU process, but the production launcher, durable assignment/lease/generation state, VFIO fd handoff, privilege boundary and DirectPath profile integration do not yet exist.
assertions: device_add and device_del return one stable product denial without reaching the QEMU backend
repeated, concurrent and pipelined attempts leave the guest PCI tree and BAR plan unchanged
VFIO fds, assignment generation, durable lease and DMA/IRQ ownership remain unchanged
the production QEMU process exposes no alternate unrestricted monitor or host-BDF attach path
